summary.text: Martin Looney was elected to the Connecticut State Senate in 1992, following six terms as a State Representative beginning in 1981.

paragraphs.text: He was first elected President Pro Tempore of the Senate in January 2015 and earlier served 12 years as Senate Majority Leader.
He is a cum laude graduate of Fairfield University, earned a master's degree in English from the University of Connecticut and received his J.D. from the UConn School of Law in 1985.
He resides in New Haven and is a partner in the law firm Keyes and Looney.
